title: Microsoft 365 One Click configurations: the two options, where each is set, and the DNS Control rule

prose.label: Rules in the other policies.
prose.text: The Firewall Control rule is in [[zia.firewall.predefined-rules]], the Cloud App Control rules in [[zia.cloud-app-control.precedence]] and the SSL/TLS Inspection rule in [[zia.ssl-inspection.rules]].

two-options.statement: Zscaler has two configuration options for Microsoft 365 traffic. Microsoft recommends using its preferred configuration because it incorporates its connectivity principles and recommendations, and the other configuration was built prior to Microsoft's current connectivity principles and recommendations.

quotes: Currently, Zscaler has two configuration options to choose from for Microsoft 365 traffic:
Microsoft recommends using their preferred configuration because it incorporates their connectivity principles and recommendations.
The following configuration was built prior to Microsoft's current connectivity principles and recommendations.

recommended-option.statement: The Microsoft-Recommended Microsoft 365 One Click Configuration option allows Zscaler to map several but not all Microsoft IP address ranges and domains for most Microsoft 365 apps, and Zscaler uses the REST-based web service published by Microsoft to keep the mapping up to date. Zscaler excludes specific Microsoft-listed FQDNs and IP address ranges from SSL/TLS Inspection, as outlined in the Microsoft 365 endpoints for Worldwide (+GCC), operated by 21 Vianet, U.S. Government DoD and U.S. Government GCC High.

quotes: The Microsoft-Recommended Microsoft 365 One Click Configuration option allows Zscaler to map several but not all Microsoft IP address ranges and domains for most Microsoft 365 apps listed in Microsoft 365 URLs and IP Address Ranges.
Zscaler leverages the REST-based web service published by Microsoft to keep this mapping up to date.
Zscaler excludes specific Microsoft-listed FQDNs and IP address ranges from SSL/TLS Inspection, as outlined in the following Microsoft 365 endpoints:
- Microsoft 365 Worldwide (+GCC)
- Microsoft 365 operated by 21 Vianet
- Microsoft 365 U.S. Government DoD
- Microsoft 365 U.S. Government GCC High

older-option.statement: With the Office 365 One Click Configuration feature, the Zscaler service automatically configures the authentication exemption and decryption exemption rules required to support and secure Microsoft 365 traffic, and if the option is enabled it exempts select Microsoft 365 applications from SSL/TLS Inspection.

quotes: With the Office 365 One Click Configuration feature, the Zscaler service automatically configures authentication exemption and decryption exemption rules required for the service to seamlessly support and secure your Microsoft 365 traffic.
If this option is enabled, the Zscaler service exempts select Microsoft 365 applications from SSL/TLS Inspection.

unpublished-exemptions.statement: Zscaler does not publish the complete list of IP address ranges and FQDNs or wildcard domain names exempted from SSL/TLS Inspection by the Microsoft-Recommended option. If further exemptions are required, SSL/TLS Inspection rules can be defined.

quotes: Zscaler does not publish the complete list of IP address ranges and FQDNs or wildcard domain names exempted from SSL/TLS Inspection. If further exemptions are required, you can define SSL/TLS Inspection rules.

option-locations.statement: The page's steps for the older option go to Internet Access > Setting > Advanced Settings and select the Enable Office 365 One Click Configuration option, and say the Enable Microsoft-Recommended Office 365 One Click Configuration option should be disabled. Its steps for the Microsoft-Recommended option go to Data Security > Inline CASB > Advanced Policy Settings and select Enable Microsoft-Recommended One Click Office 365 Configuration, and say the Office 365 One Click Configuration option should be disabled.

quotes: The Enable Microsoft-Recommended Office 365 One Click Configuration option should be disabled.
From the navigation menu, go to Internet Access > Setting > Advanced Settings.
Select the Enable Office 365 One Click Configuration option.
The Office 365 One Click Configuration option should be disabled.
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > Inline CASB > Advanced Policy Settings.
Select Enable Microsoft-Recommended One Click Office 365 Configuration.

admin-rank-error.statement: An error message after trying to enable the Microsoft-Recommended option relates to the admin rank: Zscaler compares the admin rank to that of two existing custom Firewall and DNS rules with top order, and if the admin rank is less than those two ranks, the admin does not have permission to enable the option.

evidence.after: Select Enable Microsoft-Recommended One Click Office 365 Configuration.
quotes: If you get an error message after trying to enable this option, this relates to your admin rank. We compare your admin rank to that of two existing custom Firewall and DNS rules with top order. If your admin rank is less than those two ranks, you don't have permission to enable the option.

recommended-results.statement: After the steps that enable the Microsoft-Recommended option, the page lists these results: the Office 365 One Click Configuration option is grayed out, the Zscaler service automatically configures authentication exemption for Microsoft domains, and a predefined Office 365 One Click Rule is enabled in the SSL/TLS Inspection, Firewall Control, DNS Control and Cloud App Control policies.

evidence.after: Select Enable Microsoft-Recommended One Click Office 365 Configuration.
quotes: The Office 365 One Click Configuration option is grayed out.
The Zscaler service automatically configures authentication exemption for Microsoft domains.
A predefined Office 365 One Click Rule is enabled in the following policies:
- SSL/TLS Inspection Policy
- Firewall Control Policy
- DNS Control Policy
- Cloud App Control Policy

dns-optimization.statement: Zscaler overrides the destination IP address of Microsoft 365 traffic with the closest CDN destination for the Microsoft 365 application and leverages DNS servers at each of its data centers. DNS optimization is done automatically when the Microsoft-Recommended Office 365 One Click Configuration option is enabled.

quotes: Zscaler overrides the destination IP address of Microsoft 365 traffic with the closest CDN destination for the Microsoft 365 application and leverages DNS servers at each of our data centers to provide a better user experience and improved application performance.
DNS optimization is done automatically when the Microsoft-Recommended Office 365 One Click Configuration option is enabled.

default-category.statement: Zscaler exempts some IP addresses, FQDNs or URLs from One Click if they are part of the Default category. Default category endpoints can be treated like regular destinations, which allows customers to apply the appropriate security controls.

quotes: Zscaler exempts some IP addresses, FQDNs, or URLs from One Click if they are part of the Default category. Default category endpoints can be treated like regular destinations, which allows customers to apply the appropriate security controls.

dns-rule.statement: The DNS Control One Click rule allows DNS traffic destined to Microsoft 365. It is not configurable and cannot be deleted, but its rule order can be changed, and if the admin rank is greater than or equal to that of the DNS rule with top order, the rule appears at rule order one with the admin's rank.

quotes: The rule allows DNS traffic destined to Microsoft 365. The rule isn't configurable and can't be deleted, but its rule order can be changed, if necessary.
If your admin rank is greater than or equal to that of the DNS rule with top order, then the rule appears at rule order one with your rank.
